locations.name: Blackwood Manor
locations.intro: A storm-dark estate on the moor. At nine o'clock tonight the Blackwood sapphire vanished from a locked study.

mysteries.title: The Vanished Sapphire
mysteries.question: Who stole the Blackwood sapphire?
mysteries.explanation: The front door was locked from inside, so the thief used the cellar hatch. The butler (candle receipt, 8:47pm), the gardener (witnessed in the greenhouse) and the niece (at choir until ten) all have alibis. The surgical glove scrap and the torn prescription page pointing to a pawnbroker both lead to Dr. Harlow.

clues.label: Front porch
clues.text: The front door was bolted from the inside all evening. Nobody came or went this way.

clues.label: Cellar hatch
clues.text: The cellar hatch latch is freshly oiled. Caught on it: a scrap of pale surgical glove.

clues.label: Greenhouse
clues.text: A logbook shows Edmund repotting orchids from eight until eleven, signed by the night watchman.

clues.label: Garden shed
clues.text: A crumpled receipt: Alfred bought candles in the village at 8:47pm, stamped by the shopkeeper.

clues.label: Old well
clues.text: A choir programme with Clara's name circled. She sang in the village hall until ten.

clues.label: Ancient oak
clues.text: A torn prescription page in Dr. Harlow's handwriting, with a pawnbroker's address scribbled on the back.
